card.line: Pithom was an Egyptian store city for Pharaoh, built by Israelite slaves, and it shows how harshly Egypt treated God's people before the exodus.

moments.title: Israelites build Pithom
moments.text: The Egyptians set taskmasters over the Israelites and forced them to work. They built Pithom and Rameses as store cities for Pharaoh.
